title: Prize Draw
shortDescription: Invite visitors to join a prize-driven moment that blends excitement, visibility, and light competition. Whether through a digital draw, race, spin, or reveal, it transforms giveaways into an engaging shared experience.
longDescription: Create a memorable giveaway moment that feels like part of the experience, not just an add-on. Participants enter through registration, gameplay, token scans, or challenge completions, then watch a live physics simulation play out in real time, unpredictable, unscripted, and genuinely suspenseful. Winners emerge from the chaos naturally, celebrated through branded visuals and storytelling. It runs as a standalone activation or connects with games, journey tracking, leaderboards, and post-event reward flows, and BRDGE handles the full interaction logic, physics engine, and scene management end to end.

highlights.title: 3 steps to podium
highlights.description: Visitors scan a QR code to enter, a live physics simulation (marble race, obstacle course, or custom mechanic) plays out in real time with genuine unpredictability and suspense, then finalists surface and prizes are awarded live on screen.

highlights.title: Works Standalone or Connected
highlights.description: Run it as a self-contained giveaway station or wire it into registration, token scans, gameplay outcomes, and post-event reward flows, and the same module covers all scenarios.

highlights.title: Remix the Mechanics
highlights.description: Swap the marble race for a ball drop, pinball run, or custom physics arena. Add prize tiers, sponsor-branded obstacles, a multi-heat bracket format, or audience voting on race conditions. The physics engine stays live and unscripted regardless of the skin.

highlights.title: Skin It to Any World
highlights.description: Re-dress it as a festive advent calendar reveal, a Wild West saloon poker draw, a futuristic capsule machine, a treasure hunt chest unlock, or a branded roulette wheel. Same logic, entirely different world.

highlights.title: Proof in the Numbers
highlights.description: Add a data layer that tracks entries, participation rate, draw completion events, and winner moments. Pair it with lead capture or token scans to tie prize draw activity to individual visitor profiles, exportable for client reporting.

highlights.title: Personalized and Connected
highlights.description: Pair with Journey Manager to make the draw the final reward of a multi-stop experience, with Visitor Identificator to recognize entrants and draw on real visitor data for a personalized draw, with Leaderboard to surface top-draw moments live, or with Shared Gallery to broadcast winner reactions across the venue.

states.trigger: Visitor notices the installation or receives the entry prompt
states.experience: The module communicates what to do and what can be won, inviting the first action.
states.feedback: Idle animation, prize visuals, motion graphics, or ambient cue
states.configurable: Branding, prize imagery, call-to-action text, language

states.trigger: Visitor enters the draw (via registration, scan, game completion, or tap)
states.experience: Entry is confirmed and the participant is held in suspense while the draw builds anticipation.
states.feedback: Entry confirmation, animated queue, live counter, or suspense sequence
states.configurable: Entry method, draw pacing, entry cap, eligibility rules
states.data: Entry count, entry method, timestamp, visitor ID if linked

states.trigger: Draw is triggered (live, scheduled, or threshold-based)
states.experience: Winner(s) are revealed through a playful animated sequence; non-winners get a thank-you or consolation CTA.
states.feedback: Live physics reveal, winner emergence, audio sting, confetti, name/prize display
states.configurable: Reveal style, prize tiers, winner count, consolation message, share prompt
states.data: Winner ID, prize assigned, draw timestamp, exportable results
